chain.why: According to MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026, there were about 3 hospital admissions per 100 urban residents each year, showing that hospitalisation is a relatively common occurrence.
According to MoSPI/NSO, NSS 80th round press note, 20 Apr 2026, the median cost of a private‑hospital stay was ₹24,000, indicating that a single admission can involve a substantial expense.

According to MoSPI/NSO, NSS Report no. 596 (80th round), section 2.3.2, nearly two‑thirds of urban hospital stays occur in private hospitals, where costs are typically higher than in public facilities.

conclusion: Given that hospital admissions are common, a single private stay can cost tens of thousands of rupees, and most admissions happen in private hospitals, relying only on a 5 lakh group cover may leave you exposed to significant out‑of‑pocket expenses.
